decisions.reason: Supplying the final photo collection changes gallery content but does not change the required hover-animation behavior or policy.
The supplied website photos do not affect the mobile pricing table layout or horizontal-scrolling approach.
The photo collection does not change the required number or presentation of pricing bundles.
Although supplied photos may later be used on the homepage, the source does not change the blue overlay color, opacity, or image-emphasis requirements.
The supplied photo collection has no effect on square-footage tiers, pricing values, or the package pricing model.
Providing gallery photos does not change the destinations or behavior of the homepage section buttons.
